arxiv-2003-00584.title: The Use of Change Point Detection to Identify Software Performance Regressions in a Continuous Integration System Conference: Proceedings of the 2020 ACM/SPEC International Conference on Performance Engineering; April 20–24, 2020; Edmonton, AB, Canada DOI: 10.1145/3358960.3375791 CCS: Software and i
arxiv-2003-00584.creator: David Daly, William Brown, Henrik Ingo, Jim O’Leary, David Bradford
arxiv-2003-00584.description: Abstract . We describe our process for automatic detection of performance changes for a software product in the presence of noise. A large collection of tests run periodically as changes to our software product are committed to our source repository, and we would like to identify the commits responsible for performance regressions.

arxiv-2110-02994.title: Learning Canonical Embedding for Non-rigid Shape Matching
arxiv-2110-02994.creator: Abhishek Sharma & Maks Ovsjanikov
arxiv-2110-02994.description: Abstract This paper provides a novel framework that learns canonical embeddings for non-rigid shape matching. In contrast to prior work in this direction, our framework is trained end-to-end and thus avoids instabilities and constraints associated with the commonly-used Laplace-Beltrami basis or sequential optimization schemes.

arxiv-2307-00657.title: Rainbow Greedy Matching Algorithms
arxiv-2307-00657.creator: Patrick Bennett, Colin Cooper, Alan Frieze
arxiv-2307-00657.description: Abstract We consider the problem of finding a large rainbow matching in a random graph with randomly colored edges. In particular we analyze the performance of two greedy algorithms for this problem. The algorithms we study are colored versions of algorithms that were previously used to find large matchings in random graphs (i.e. the color-free version of our present problem).

arxiv-2307-06163.title: Gauss-Bonnet Dark Energy and the Speed of Gravitational Waves
arxiv-2307-06163.creator: José Jaime Terente Díaz, Konstantinos Dimopoulos, Mindaugas Karčiauskas, Antonio Racioppi
arxiv-2307-06163.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by José Jaime Terente Díaz, Konstantinos Dimopoulos, Mindaugas Karčiauskas, Antonio Racioppi. Gauss-Bonnet Dark Energy has been a popular model to explain the accelerated expansion of the Universe. Quite generically it also predicts the speed of gravitational waves c GW c_{\mathrm{GW}} to be different from the speed of light. This fact alone led some authors to exclude such models in view of the new tight observational constraints on c GW c_{\mathrm{GW}} .

arxiv-2309-01663.title: Anomaly zones for uniformly sampled gene trees under the gene duplication and loss model
arxiv-2309-01663.creator: Brandon Legried
arxiv-2309-01663.description: Abstract Recently, there has been interest in extending long-known results about the multispecies coalescent tree to other models of gene trees. Results about the gene duplication and loss (GDL) tree have mathematical proofs, including species tree identifiability, estimability, and sample complexity of popular algorithms like ASTRAL.

arxiv-2402-11011.title: Fundamental, Harmonic, and Third-harmonic Plasma Emission from Beam-plasma Instabilities: A First-principles Precursor for Astrophysical Radio Bursts Fundamental, Harmonic, and Third-harmonic Plasma Emission from Beam-plasma Instabilities: A First-principles Precursor for Astrophysical Radio Bursts
arxiv-2402-11011.creator: Fabio Bacchini, Alexander A. Philippov
arxiv-2402-11011.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fabio Bacchini, Alexander A. Philippov. Electromagnetic fundamental and harmonic emission is ubiquitously observed throughout the heliosphere, and in particular it is commonly associated with the occurrence of Type II and III solar radio bursts. Classical analytic calculations for the plasma-emission process, though useful, are limited to idealized situations; a conclusive numerical verification of this theory is still lacking, with earlier studies often providing contradicting results on e.g. the precise parameter space in which fundamental and harmonic emission can be produced.

arxiv-2408-02387.title: Dirichlet problem on perturbed conical domains via converging generalized power series
arxiv-2408-02387.creator: Martin Costabel, Matteo Dalla Riva, Monique Dauge, Paolo Musolino
arxiv-2408-02387.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Martin Costabel, Matteo Dalla Riva, Monique Dauge, Paolo Musolino. We consider the Poisson equation with homogeneous Dirichlet conditions in a family of domains in ℝ n {\mathbb{R}}^{n} indexed by a small parameter ε \varepsilon . The domains depend on ε \varepsilon only within a ball of radius proportional to ε \varepsilon and, as ε \varepsilon tends to zero, they converge in a self-similar way to a domain with a conical boundary singularity.

arxiv-2411-12524.title: Assessing a Template-Based Approach for Core-Collapse Supernova Gravitational-Wave Detection
arxiv-2411-12524.creator: Haakon Andresen 1,∗, Bella Finkel 2
arxiv-2411-12524.description: Abstract Gravitational waves from core-collapse supernovae are a promising yet challenging target for detection due to the stochastic and complex nature of these signals. Conventional detection methods for core-collapse supernovae rely on excess energy searches because matched filtering has been hindered by the lack of well-defined waveform templates.

arxiv-2504-10172.title: Characterising quantum measurement through environmental stochastic entropy production in a two spin 1/2 system
arxiv-2504-10172.creator: Sophia M. Walls, Adam Bloss and Ian J. Ford
arxiv-2504-10172.description: Abstract Quantum state diffusion is a framework within which measurement may be described as the continuous and gradual collapse of a quantum system to an eigenstate as a result of interaction with its environment. The irreversible nature of the quantum trajectories that arise may be characterised by the environmental stochastic entropy production associated with the measurement.

arxiv-2507-20136.title: Multi-Stage Verification-Centric Framework for Mitigating Hallucination in Multi-Modal RAG Conference: 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 03–07, 2025; Toronto, Canada CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language generation CCS: Information systems Question ans
arxiv-2507-20136.creator: Baiyu Chen, Wilson Wongso, Xiaoqian Hu, Yue Tan, Flora Salim
arxiv-2507-20136.description: Abstract . This paper presents the technical solution developed by team CRUISE for the KDD Cup 2025 Meta Comprehensive RAG Benchmark for Multi-modal, Multi-turn (CRAG-MM) challenge. The challenge aims to address a critical limitation of modern Vision Language Models (VLMs): their propensity to hallucinate, especially when faced with egocentric imagery, long-tail entities, and complex, multi-hop questions.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-joseph-octave.creator: Lionel Lindsay
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-joseph-octave.description: Article 'Joseph-Octave Plessis' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10658953.title: Effectiveness of the Stress Process Model-Based Program in Dementia Caregiving (DeCare-SPM) for Family Caregivers: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-10658953.creator: Jun Wang, Hongmei Chen, Lin Yang, Xiuli Yu, Dandan Zhang, Qinghua Zhao, Mingzhao Xiao
pmc-10658953.description: This paper aims to describe a randomized controlled trial protocol evaluating the effectiveness, cost, and process of a stress process model-based program in dementia caregiving (DeCare-SPM) for family caregivers. Family caregivers of individuals with dementia will be recruited from memory clinics and community settings and randomly assigned to either DeCare-SPM or usual care.

pmc-11445901.title: FASN contributes to ADM resistance of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma by inhibiting ferroptosis via nf-κB/STAT3/GPX4 axis
pmc-11445901.creator: Xing Zhong, Weiwei Zhang, Weiming Zhang, Nasha Yu, Wuping Li, Xiangxiang Song
pmc-11445901.description: Drug resistance is a critical impediment to efficient therapy of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) patients. Recent studies have highlighted the association between ferroptosis and drug resistance that has been reported. Fatty acid synthase (FASN) is always related to a poor prognosis.

pmc-11504237.title: Mathematical Models for Ultrasound Elastography: Recent Advances to Improve Accuracy and Clinical Utility
pmc-11504237.creator: Ali Farajpour, Wendy V Ingman, Yunfeng Wu
pmc-11504237.description: Changes in biomechanical properties such as elasticity modulus, viscosity, and poroelastic features are linked to the health status of biological tissues. Ultrasound elastography is a non-invasive imaging tool that quantitatively maps these biomechanical characteristics for diagnostic and treatment monitoring purposes.

pmc-13187186.title: Theoretical study on the pressure relief range of the upper protected coal seam in protective layer mining
pmc-13187186.creator: Keliang Zhan, Bao Zhang, Mengjun Wang
pmc-13187186.description: The mining of protective layers is recognized as an economical and effective measure for pressure relief, anti-erosion and prevention of coal and gas outbursts. To explore the influence law of protective layer mining on the pressure relief range of the protected coal seam, this paper takes the No. 6 Mine of Pingdingshan Tian’an Coal Industry Co., Ltd. as an example.

pmc-13319716.title: Protocol for spatiotemporal analysis of climate-induced negative sentiment in social media
pmc-13319716.creator: Tareq Al-Ahdal, Sandra Barman, Barrak Alahmad, Joacim Rocklöv

pmc-13646001.title: Practical wisdom in medicine: defending a multidimensional, integrated view of an indispensable virtue
pmc-13646001.creator: Lauris C. Kaldjian, Kristján Kristjánsson, Shane McLoughlin
pmc-13646001.description: By defending practical wisdom (phronesis) as a multidimensional virtue that complements the moral virtues, we offer a critique of “practical wisdom eliminativism”, with special attention to the context of medicine, arguing that the core dimensions of practical wisdom enjoy broad consensus.
